name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
title: IKIO Technologies Ltd - 543923 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 47% YoY to INR165 cr and FY26 EBITDA margin ~13%, but management guides FY27 growth of 20-22% with working capital stretched and no order book; supply-side evidence thin.

utilisation.quote: the mature units are working at good efficiency levels, close to around anywhere, if I have to give a number, vaguely around 70% plus

capex.quote: we are, I think, left with around -- from the IPO proceeds, somewhere around INR35 crores, INR36 crores of CapEx, which we intend to utilize in this financial year

triggers.label: Working capital hit; 2-3 quarters more
triggers.quote: working capital has been sort of got a slight hit because of whatever is happening geopolitically

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 20-22%
triggers.quote: somewhere close to around 20% to 22% growth in FY '27

triggers.label: No order book; US business not started
triggers.quote: business has not yet started because, again, of whatever was happening geopolitically

triggers.label: Mature units ~70%+, new units lower
triggers.quote: the mature units are working at good efficiency levels, close to around anywhere, if I have to give a number, vaguely around 70% plus

guidance.quote: somewhere close to around 20% to 22% growth in FY '27
Yes, around -- yes, same line, 15% to 16%.
our target is also to reach around 18% to 20%
somewhere around INR35 crores, INR36 crores of CapEx, which we intend to utilize in this financial year

red_flags.label: Working capital stretched; inventory build from design changes
red_flags.quote: we are now having multiple inventories because, let's say, a certain design, we are not able to produce because of shortage of a certain component

red_flags.label: Single-customer concentration (Signify) falling sales
red_flags.quote: there has been a decline also in the sales in the Home Lighting segment

red_flags.label: Management says no order book; FY27 guidance is planning-based
red_flags.quote: So we don't have an order book kind of situation with our customers.

red_flags.label: Utilisation not disclosed on consolidated basis
red_flags.quote: it's very hard to comment on the utilization level on a console basis

evasions.quote: it's very hard to comment on the utilization level on a console basis
I honestly don't have that number right now in front of me
we are not in the right time right now
